audit_items.proof_trace: `ensure_limit_breached` (adl.move:215-217) asserts `target_amount < current_value` (strict), blocking ADL whenever `total_debt <= target_amount`. In `handle_debt_auto_deleverage` (market.move:578-582), interest is accrued before `total_debt` is read from `reserve.debt.floor()`, ensuring the check uses the current aggregate debt. This is the sole code path to trigger borrow ADL (`handle_debt_auto_deleverage` is called only from `liquidate_adl_borrow` and is `public(package)` + gated by `PackageCallerCap`); no bypass exists.
